subject: Request: Temporary SLO amendment for West Coast P1/P2 shift
messages:
From: Anya Petrova <anya@finregco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinRegCo SRE <sre@finregco.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary SLO amendment for West Coast P1/P2 shift

Hi Rafael / Laura,

Quick context: were doing a planned migration of a critical billing microservice between our us-west clusters on 2025-08-16 -> 2025-08-23. During that window we expect a small but sustained increase in alert volume overnight (00:00-06:00 PT) and were concerned about escalating response latency impacting our go/no-go.

As discussed with our ops leads, wed like to request a temporary SLO amendment for the West Coast region only:
- P1 (sev 1) response SLA: 15m -> 30m (window: 2025-08-16 00:00 PT to 2025-08-23 06:00 PT)
- P2 response SLA: 60m -> 120m for the same window

Were happy to accept additional escalation steps (war-room on-call, pager rotation overlap) and to provide extended incident context to support faster mitigation. Please let us know if Redwood can approve this carveout for the finite window and what artifacts you need to make it formal (DocuSign, amended SLA exhibit, operational runbook).

Thanks,
Anya
Anya Petrova
SRE Lead, FinRegCo
attachments: regional-incident-history.csv (summary of last 12 months)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Petrova <anya@finregco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary SLO amendment for West Coast P1/P2 shift

Anya — thanks for the heads-up and the incident history. Appreciate the clear window.

Summary of next steps from our side:
1) We can provision a time-limited SLO exception scoped to the us-west region and the exact dates you provided. Well require an internal change request + written acceptance from FinRegCo (DocuSign ok).
2) For P1, increasing the response target to 30m is plausible if we activate staggered on-call coverage for the overnight window. That entails an ops rota adjustment for two weeks and an explicit escalation path if a P1 remains open past 30m.
3) For P2, 120m is acceptable as a temporary adjustment.

To get this into our change control we need:
- Signed amendment (Ill attach a draft exhibit)
- Confirmation of the migration runbook (a single anchor doc or a link to the Google folder)
- Point of contact for 24/7 war-room coordination (pager/email + phone)

Ive looped in Ben and Laura to confirm contractual and CS impacts (billing/credits, and account-level visibility). Ill draft the amendment and share a DocuSign link by EOD.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anya Petrova <anya@finregco.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary SLO amendment for West Coast P1/P2 shift

Appreciate the quick triage. A couple of commercial/ops notes from my side:
- Well treat this as a temporary operational amendment (no change to the master service agreement); if FinRegCo accepts the exhibit we can apply it without a pricing adjustment.
- If alert volume materially exceeds the scenario in Anya's attachment, we reserve the right to convert this to a formal credit discussion — Ill add a threshold clause to the exhibit.

Operational asks:
- Can FinRegCo provide a named war-room lead (mobile + backup)? We want a single escalation contact for midnight hours.
- Laura / Evelyn: please confirm that the on-call overlap plan (staggered staffing 23:00-07:00 PT) can be staffed from our existing rotas. If we need overtime, flag it here so we can route for approval.

Evelyn, can you run a quick check on the rota and tell us whether we can staff the requested overlap for the two-week window without a roster change? If not, well propose a paid temporary on-call supplement.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Petrova <anya@finregco.com>, FinRegCo SRE <sre@finregco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary SLO amendment for West Coast P1/P2 shift — Proposed amendment and escalation path

Anya — following internal review we can approve the requested temporary SLO amendment subject to the conditions below. Attached is the final exhibit (p1-oncall-coverage-proposal.pdf) and a short escalation runbook.

Conditions (summary):
- Scope: us-west only, 2025-08-16 00:00 PT -> 2025-08-23 06:00 PT
- P1 response: 30 minutes for first triage; if open past 30 minutes, automatic escalation to on-call lead + 1 senior engineer (pager) and war-room channel activation
- P2 response: 120 minutes for initial assessment
- Threshold clause: if inbound alerts during the window exceed 3x the 95th percentile from the attached incident history, Redwood may pause the exception and re-engage commercial review
- Documentation: FinRegCo to sign the attached exhibit in DocuSign and provide a named war-room lead with contact details at least 72 hours before the window

If that all looks good, please sign the DocuSign (link in the attached exhibit) and well activate the rota changes. Ive also added a Jira ticket for tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-812

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
attachments: p1-oncall-coverage-proposal.pdf
